lastCompletedStory.title: runPostAuditAction flips phase:implementing on APPROVE+auto; keeps escalate-on-BLOCK

nextStoryContext: US-003 retargeted runPostAuditAction to use setPhaseFn: (phase: LoopPhase) => void instead of flipActiveFn: () => void. Key changes: (1) plan-runner.ts gained LoopPhase import and renamed flipActiveFn -> setPhaseFn in RunPostAuditOptions; the call site is now setPhaseFn('implementing'). (2) sidecar.ts exported a new makeSetPhaseFn(claudeDir, cwd): (phase: LoopPhase) => void factory that writes phase:<value> to .claude/cam-loop.local.md preserving all other fields; makeFlipActiveFn was simplified to delegate to makeSetPhaseFn('implementing'). (3) test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-postaudit.test.ts updated all flipActiveFn/flipCount references to setPhaseFn/setPhaseCalls with phase-value assertions (AC5). (4) New test/commands/sidecar-set-phase.test.ts tests makeSetPhaseFn production behavior (AC2). file-size-budget.json raised sidecar.ts 840->853. All 2587 tests pass. The next story (US-004) should build on this injectable setPhaseFn seam for the plan-phase loop integration or other post-audit wiring.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-003 only touches cam-cli internals (plan-runner.ts, sidecar.ts, status.ts) and Bun/Node built-ins. No external library exercised.
